notes: Fixed a real bug causing wrong/off-topic companies to leak into results (e.g. unrelated brands getting marked relevant during a second-pass AI check) - verified via real before/after test runs. Fixed a Windows console encoding bug that could silently kill a run mid-way with no useful error. Fixed a couple of smaller accuracy issues (a generic-word check that was hiding some name/website mismatches, and an API key mix-up that was quietly weakening enrichment quality on some setups). Sped up part of the discovery step by batching searches that were running one at a time. Note: overall run time is not meaningfully faster yet - that's still being worked on separately.
